subject: Re: Andrew Langmaid
message:
Hi Andrew,

Thanks for writing, and no, I don't mind at all. Direct approaches tend to be the good ones.

You are right that we have no commercial role advertised at the moment. There is, though, a live question on my desk about how we add hands-on commercial capacity, so your timing is better than you might think.

To be straight with you about what it would and would not be. What I am considering is a hands-on, full-cycle new business role: someone who personally builds pipeline and closes it, working alongside me, with an account executive and a project manager as resources. It is not a leadership seat and I am not looking to fill one. Reading your email, that sounds like what you actually want rather than something you would put up with, which is the main reason I wanted to reply.

A word on what we sell, because it is not an easy product. CarbonCloud is climate data software for the food and beverage industry. The buyer is often a sustainability lead who knows the science better than we know their supply chain, cycles run three to six months, and a lot of the work is understanding what a customer is really asking for and whether we can honestly deliver it. Not your sector, which is one of the things I would want to talk about rather than one of the things that puts me off.

Could you come by our office on Thursday? I'm flexible from 09:30 to 12:00, whenever works for you. Allow an hour. The address is Aschebergsgatan 44.

Treat it as exploratory in both directions. There is nothing to apply for yet, and no expectations on either side.

Best,
David Bryngelsson

My role with Smartvel is coming to an end, and I am deliberately looking for a permanent, hands-on international sales and new-business position.

Across nearly 30 years in commercial roles, what may distinguish me is the pattern across my career:

-
Entrepreneurial drive: I founded and self-financed Pomeroi Fine Jewellers in the UK. Later, I established Luxury
Sweden, wrote the business plan, secured Swedish government start-up funding and agreed distribution terms with several brands.

-
Commercial results: At Padani, I increased UK turnover by approximately 80% in my first year. Later, at ArrivalGuides
while it was part of Lonely Planet, I introduced personalised B2B outreach that generated 320% more qualified opportunities and scheduled meetings in the first six months of 2020 than in the comparable 2019 period.

-
Earned trust: After eight years helping to develop an established central London business, its owner asked me
to take it over. After delivering growth at Padani, I was invited to become a partner. In 2022, ArrivalGuides' owners asked me to stabilise the company and lead its sale.

-
Still hands-on: Following ArrivalGuides' acquisition by Smartvel, approximately 80% of my work has remained hands-on
international new business, managing the complete sales process from identifying target accounts through to negotiation, contracts and signature.

These experiences span premium brands, entrepreneurship, wholesale, retail and B2B technology. The common thread has been my ability to learn a new proposition
quickly, understand its commercial value, develop its market and turn opportunities into revenue.

Although my current title is CEO, I am not looking for another CEO position. I want to apply this experience in a permanent role where I can personally create
opportunities and close international new business.

No suitable commercial position appears to be advertised at present, but I'm hoping there may be a need for someone with my background, either now or in

subject: Respons - Grale
message:
Hi Andrew,

Thanks for reaching out, and great to connect! Allen forwarded your email to me, so I wanted to pick up the conversation from here.

I had a look through your message and background, and it’s certainly an interesting one. As you mentioned, we don’t currently have a specific role advertised that seems to directly match what you’re looking for.

That said, I’d be curious to hear a bit more about what type of role you could see yourself stepping into at Grale. Given where we are as a company, our growth ambitions and the market we operate in, what do you see yourself being able to contribute from a commercial perspective?

In particular, it would be interesting to hear where you think your experience could create the most value for us at this stage.

Feel free to share a few thoughts, and if it sounds like there could be an interesting fit, we can take it from there.

Best,

We exist to make a positive impact on the world.

subject: Re: Andrew Langmaid
message:
Dear Andrew,

Many thanks for your interest in our fine company. And for your CV.

As you mention, we are not currently looking to add to the export team. We are at a pivotal moment so things may however change. Still, even then we will be looking for help with the product development side of things, admin-heavy role. Not the onhands international sales you are looking for.

As such, we are not a good match to your ambitions.

Of course, I am happy to forward your mail to HR if you are interested in the product management side of things where we liaise with global brandpartners to grow their sales in Scandinavia.

Either way, all the best of luck with your search for the right next step.

Many thanks again,
Lisbet
